briefing: Teal never signed your checkout. Fly the training pattern, practice the controls, then select and hit the training radar. No enemies.
debrief: Checkout interrupted: six bombers are crossing the islands. Mission 1 is ready when you are.
failure: The checkout can be flown again.

phases.beat: Tap turn and pitch briefly. Three seconds TOTAL each; impacts reset you.
phases.label: Practice short turn and pitch taps

phases.beat: Select radar: TGT / Tab / Y. Follow marker; turn back if you pass it.
phases.label: Cycle to the training target

phases.beat: Aim for LOCK, then FIRE / Space / RT. Pull up after firing.
phases.label: Lock and hit the training radar

title: Practice

briefing: Teal's unsigned checkout is cut short. Six bombers in Varda's own paint are crossing the islands toward Varda Rim's runway on the headland. They squawk our codes; the warning came late. You are the nearest jet. Fly off the training carrier and stop them. Escorts are optional targets.
debrief: The six bombers are down and Varda Rim's runway is clear. The quartermaster hands you a sealed case from Teal's bunk, addressed to Sera.
failure: The raid was not stopped. Varda Rim's runway remains under threat.

phases.beat: Six bombers, our paint and codes. Stop them before the north coast.

bombers.escapeCall: The bombers crossed the north coast. Varda Rim, clear the runway.

phases.label: Intercept six bombers

primary: Destroy all six bombers before they leave the island
title: OUR OWN PAINT

briefing: The grain drums in Teal's manifest lead north to a 'farm' with a runway and no animals. Yesterday's bombers flew from it; eleven more are parked on its pads. Follow the power line and destroy them before they raid. Hangars, AA guns, the tower and the substation are optional. Hit aircraft, not the farmhouses.
debrief: All eleven bombers are burning on their pads. The farm will not launch another raid. Sera wants to know who paid for its runway.
failure: The bombers survived. The farm can launch its next raid.

phases.beat: SERA: Follow the power line north. Their bombers are parked on the farm.

chatter.text: FARM CONTROL: Bombers, start engines! Get them off the ground!
SERA: Four down. Their guns are still up, watch the base edges.
FARM CONTROL: The pads are burning. Nobody takes off from here.
LANTERN 2: One bomber left. Finish it, trainee.

fighterWaves.call: LANTERN 2: Two bandits off the nose, low over the fields.
FARM CONTROL: Raid from the south. This is not a drill!
FARM CONTROL: Runway is yours. Get up, get up!
SERA: Two more from the west valley. They waited for you.

phases.label: Destroy eleven parked bombers

standaloneAce.call: HARROW SIX: Harrow Six, rolling in. Get off my pads, trainee.
standaloneAce.name: HARROW SIX
stageLines: HARROW SIX: Varda paint on a Varda kid. Shame to waste it.
HARROW SIX: Harrow, breaking low. Somebody cover the bombers!

primary: Destroy all eleven parked bombers on the farm airfield
title: NO ANIMALS

briefing: Teal's receiver names a radar inside our own training box that nobody signed for: nine domes on two snowy mountain sites north-west of the pass. Destroy all nine with the gun camera running, then turn south across the return line and land with the film. AA guns and a parked helicopter are optional.
debrief: Nine domes are down and the film is home. Sera locks the gun-camera tape in her desk: the station was watching trainees, not the sky.
failure: The station is still watching, and the film never reached Varda Rim.

phases.beat: SERA: Enemy airspace. Site one is on the ridge north-west of you.

chatter.text: LANTERN 2: Dome down. Good hit, trainee.
SERA: Five domes down. Site two is on the saddle west-north-west.
LANTERN 2: One dome left. Finish it and we go home.

fighterWaves.call: RIDGE STATION: Intruders from the south-east. Fighters, intercept.
RIDGE STATION: Escorts, keep them away from the domes!
SERA: Site one is silent. Three fighters inbound from the west.

phases.label: Destroy nine radar domes

standaloneAce.call: CAIRN LEAD: You found our little station. Now you stay up here.
standaloneAce.name: CAIRN LEAD
stageLines: CAIRN LEAD: A training jet. They sent a training jet.
CAIRN LEAD: Missile! Breaking hard. Cairn is hit!

update.objective: Return to base: fly south across the return line
radio: SERA: All nine domes confirmed destroyed. Good work.
SERA: All aircraft, turn south. Cross the return line to leave the area.
SERA: Follow the green cue to the white dashes on the ground below.

radio.text: RIM TOWER: Trainee, gear check. Cleared to land, runway three-six.
RIM TOWER: Runway in sight. You're on the centreline.
RIM TOWER: Short final. Glide path is good, hold it there.
RIM TOWER: Touchdown. Nice and gentle.
RIM TOWER: Welcome home. Sera wants that film before you unstrap.

primary: Destroy all nine radar domes, then return to base
title: NOBODY SIGNED

briefing: The granddaughter's thumbprints marked three silos. Behind them on the coast is a whole fuel works: a refinery on the shore to the west and a drilling rig out at sea to the east, and it fuels every coup jet on the rim. Burn it before dawn. Score 2,000 points in ten minutes, then keep burning until the clock runs out. Land at the base south of the start to rearm if you run dry. And watch the dark: the pilot who hunted Teal flies here at night, with his lights off.
debrief: The fuel works burned until dawn and you crossed the line home. Vulture Lead turned back with his lights off. Sera has his voice on tape now, from the guard channel.
failure: The fuel works is still pumping. The coup's jets fly again tomorrow.

phases.beat: SERA: Rig to the east, refinery to the west. Burn them before dawn.

chatter.text: LANTERN 2: Tanks are going up like flares. Keep it coming.
SERA: Halfway there. The platform's guns are still awake.
LANTERN 3: Nearly there. Don't stop at the number, trainee.
SERA: That's two thousand. Keep burning it until the clock runs out.

fighterWaves.call: SERA: Two interceptors off the platform, low over the water.
LANTERN 2: Helicopters lifting off the platform. Three of them.
WORKS CONTROL: All reserves, get up! Protect the platform!
SERA: Two more bandits, bearing three-three-zero. Fast movers.

phases.label: Score 2,000 points before 10:00

radio.text: SHORE TOWER: Trainee, you're cleared to land, runway one-eight.
SHORE TOWER: One mile. On the glide path, hold it there.
SHORE TOWER: Touchdown. Ground crew's loading you now.
SHORE TOWER: Cleared for takeoff. Height limit lifted. Go back.

standaloneAce.call: CINDER LEAD: Cinder Lead on station. Nobody burns my works and leaves.
standaloneAce.name: CINDER LEAD
stageLines: CINDER LEAD: That's a trainee? Somebody lied to me.
CINDER LEAD: Cinder is hit! Breaking off over the tanks!

after: VULTURE LEAD: Vulture flight, you're cleared. Anything that isn't ours.
LANTERN 3: Don't engage them! Jettison and run for the line!

captions.text: LANTERN 2: Five of them. No lights. That's the Vulture flight.
SERA: All aircraft, disengage. Head south across the line, now.

standaloneAce.name: VULTURE LEAD
stageLines: VULTURE LEAD: Teal flew like that. Right up until the pass.
VULTURE LEAD: Vulture Lead is hit. Somebody get this kid off me!

update.objective: Withdraw south across the line before the clock runs out
radio: SERA: Clock's out and the works is burning. Good. Now go south.
SERA: Heavy group from the north. Five aircraft, and they're hot.

primary: Score 2,000 points at the fuel works within 10:00, then withdraw south
title: LIGHTS OFF
